# Products

Part of the **Inventory** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List products

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/products`

Retrieve a paginated list of products with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: parent, variants, uom, uomPO, category, attributes, attribute_values, tags, company, creator, propertyAccountIncome, propertyAccountExpense, routes, responsible | `category,tags,routes` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by | `architecto` |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by product name (partial match) | `Widget` |
| `filter[type]` | string | No | Filter by product type values | `goods` |
| `filter[enable_sales]` | boolean | No | Filter by sales enabled | `true` |
| `filter[enable_purchase]` | boolean | No | Filter by purchase enabled | `true` |
| `filter[category_id]` | string | No | Filter by category IDs | `architecto` |
| `filter[tracking]` | string | No | Filter by tracking values | `qty` |
| `filter[is_storable]` | boolean | No | Filter by storable products | `true` |
| `filter[responsible_id]` | string | No | Filter by responsible user IDs | `architecto` |
| `filter[trashed]` | string | No | Filter by trashed status ("with" or "only") | `with` |
| `sort` | string | No | Sort field | `-created_at` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/products?include=category%2Ctags%2Croutes&filter%5Bid%5D=architecto&filter%5Bname%5D=Widget&filter%5Btype%5D=goods&filter%5Benable_sales%5D=true&filter%5Benable_purchase%5D=true&filter%5Bcategory_id%5D=architecto&filter%5Btracking%5D=qty&filter%5Bis_storable%5D=true&filter%5Bresponsible_id%5D=architecto&filter%5Btrashed%5D=with&sort=-created_at" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

## Create product

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/products`

Create a new inventory product

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `type` | string | Yes | Product type: goods, service, consu (consumable). |
| `name` | string | Yes | Product name (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `service_tracking` | string | No | Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `reference` | string | No | Internal reference code (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `barcode` | string | No | Product barcode (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `price` | number | Yes | Sales price (minimum 0). Must be at least 0. |
| `cost` | number | No | Product cost (minimum 0). Must be at least 0. |
| `volume` | number | No | Product volume (min 0, max 99999999999). Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `weight` | number | No | Product weight (min 0, max 99999999999). Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `description` | string | No | Product description. |
| `description_purchase` | string | No | Purchase description. |
| `description_sale` | string | No | Sales description. |
| `enable_sales` | boolean | No | Whether this product can be sold. |
| `enable_purchase` | boolean | No | Whether this product can be purchased. |
| `is_favorite` | boolean | No | Mark this product as favorite. |
| `images` | string[] | No |  |
| `uom_id` | integer | No | Unit of measure ID. |
| `uom_po_id` | integer | No | Purchase unit of measure ID. |
| `category_id` | integer | Yes | Product category ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `company_id` | integer | No | Company ID this product belongs to. |
| `tags` | integer[] | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `is_storable` | boolean | No | Whether inventory is tracked for this product. |
| `tracking` | string | No | Inventory tracking method. |
| `use_expiration_date` | boolean | No | Enable expiration dates for this product. |
| `sale_delay` | number | No | Delivery lead time in days. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `expiration_time` | number | No | Expiration time in days. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `use_time` | number | No | Best before time in days. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `removal_time` | number | No | Removal time in days. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `alert_time` | number | No | Alert time in days. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `responsible_id` | integer | No | Responsible user ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `routes` | integer[] | No | Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group


## Show product

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/products/{id}`

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|

**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |

## Update product

<Badge type="tip" text="PUT" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/products/{id}`

Update an existing inventory product

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | Yes | The product ID |



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `type` | string | No | Product type: goods, service, consu (consumable). |
| `name` | string | No | Product name (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `service_tracking` | string | No | Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `reference` | string | No | Internal reference code (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `barcode` | string | No | Product barcode (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `price` | number | No | Sales price (minimum 0). Must be at least 0. |
| `cost` | number | No | Product cost (minimum 0). Must be at least 0. |
| `volume` | number | No | Product volume (min 0, max 99999999999). Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `weight` | number | No | Product weight (min 0, max 99999999999). Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `description` | string | No | Product description. |
| `description_purchase` | string | No | Purchase description. |
| `description_sale` | string | No | Sales description. |
| `enable_sales` | boolean | No | Whether this product can be sold. |
| `enable_purchase` | boolean | No | Whether this product can be purchased. |
| `is_favorite` | boolean | No | Mark this product as favorite. |
| `images` | string[] | No |  |
| `uom_id` | integer | No | Unit of measure ID. |
| `uom_po_id` | integer | No | Purchase unit of measure ID. |
| `category_id` | integer | No | Product category ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `company_id` | integer | No | Company ID this product belongs to. |
| `tags` | integer[] | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `is_storable` | boolean | No | Whether inventory is tracked for this product. |
| `tracking` | string | No | Inventory tracking method. |
| `use_expiration_date` | boolean | No | Enable expiration dates for this product. |
| `sale_delay` | number | No | Delivery lead time in days. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `expiration_time` | number | No | Expiration time in days. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `use_time` | number | No | Best before time in days. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `removal_time` | number | No | Removal time in days. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `alert_time` | number | No | Alert time in days. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `responsible_id` | integer | No | Responsible user ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `routes` | integer[] | No | Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group
